name: flags
title: Feature flags
description: OpenFeature feature flags for Lunora — declare a `defineFlags` provider in lunora/flags.ts and codegen wires `ctx.flags` onto every query, mutation, and action context. Ships with an in-memory provider; swap to Cloudflare Flagship for production.
docs: After installing, run `lunora codegen` — codegen discovers the `defineFlags()` call in lunora/flags.ts and wires `ctx.flags` onto every context. Read flags with the fallback POSITIONALLY (ctx.flags.number("page_size", 25)), and use ctx.flags.details.* for the OpenFeature EvaluationDetails. memoryProvider takes a plain key -> value map (page_size: 25), not a descriptor object — wrapping a value in { defaultValue, type } registers that object as the flag's value and every read then falls back to its call-site default. When ready for production, provision a Cloudflare Flagship account, add a FLAGS binding to wrangler.jsonc, add @cloudflare/flagship-binding to your package.json (this item does not declare it), and swap the provider to flagshipProvider({ binding: "FLAGS" }).
